entity.summary: Dubai-regulated DeFi and exchange platform providing spot trading in tokenized real-world assets alongside launchpad and investment products.
entity.notes: The current MANTRA Finance site presents a Spot DEX for tokenized real-world assets and describes the platform as licensed by VARA in Dubai for spot trading and DeFi. VARA lists Mantra Finance FZE under reference VL/25/02/001 with active Exchange Services, Broker-Dealer Services, and Management and Investment Services permissions, including a DeFi Limited Licence condition. The regulated MANTRA Finance product is recorded separately from the broader MANTRA Chain identity, and no exact launch date is inferred from the licence issue date.

evidence.title: MANTRA Finance compliant DeFi platform
evidence.notes: Current first-party site presents an operating Spot DEX and related RWA products and states that MANTRA Finance is licensed by VARA in Dubai for spot trading and DeFi.

evidence.title: Mantra Finance FZE public register entry
evidence.notes: Official VARA entry identifies Mantra Finance FZE, reference VL/25/02/001, Exchange Services, Broker-Dealer Services, Management and Investment Services, the DeFi Limited Licence condition, and active status.
